amendment.claim_status: DASF remains secondary and exploratory because this order was clarified after the seed-level fits
amendment.reason: make the implemented DASF order match the stated method and reviewer requirement: aggregate five seeds first, then make one gate decision per outer cell
amendment.scope: prediction derivation only; no fitted model, split, hyperparameter or seed-level validation diagnostic was changed
amendment.timing: after seed-level clean DASF fits and before the final Route A prediction freeze or deep-baseline full runs

dasf_clean.decision: select always_fuse only when cross-fitted recording accuracy exceeds always_nn by more than the effective margin; otherwise select always_nn
dasf_clean.execution_order: form the five-seed median probability ensemble first, then apply the single outer-cell gate; seed-specific gate decisions are diagnostics only and never define final predictions
dasf_clean.gate_evidence_aggregation: take the median validation accuracy and covariance shift across the five frozen seed fits, then make one decision per outer participant/direction cell
dasf_clean.output_invariant: every output probability row is exactly an input always_nn or always_fuse row
dasf_clean.shift: normalized Frobenius distance between source and unlabeled target mean 8-channel covariance matrices
dasf_clean.validation_crossfit_group: recording for cross-task and participant for LOSO

deep_training.ensemble: five frozen seeds combined by window-level median probability
deep_training.final_epochs: median selected inner-fold epoch, rounded to the nearest integer
deep_training.loso_inner: complete participant-level LOSO within each outer-training set

leakage_audit.learner: fixed StandardScaler plus balanced logistic regression
leakage_audit.purpose: methodological audit only; never used for model or hyperparameter selection

method_roles.fixed_blend_010: secondary exploratory baseline selected after the primary OpenBCI analysis
method_roles.fixed_blend_025: secondary exploratory baseline selected after the primary OpenBCI analysis

raw_preprocessing.channels: the same first eight EEG columns used by the corrected feature pipeline
raw_preprocessing.filter: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth SOS applied per recording before windowing
raw_preprocessing.normalization: per-window, per-channel z-score using that window only

recording_aggregation: geometric mean of window probabilities, then argmax

recording_stacker.cross_task_meta_split: leave target participant out; fit on recording predictions from the other 14 participants in the same direction
recording_stacker.features: logit probabilities from always_nn and the window-level OOF always_fuse stacker
recording_stacker.limitation: secondary descriptive two-input meta-baseline; cross-task meta-training uses outer predictions from other participants
recording_stacker.loso_meta_split: fit only on recording-level inner-OOF predictions from the 14 outer-training participants

riemannian.deterministic_seed_policy: fit once per outer cell and repeat identical probabilities in the five seed slots only for a common ensemble schema; seeds are never statistical replicates

seed_aggregation: per-class median probability at window level
